test_json_recognizer_accept_prefix: test the StringRecognizer to verify if a JSON string is a valid prefix of the grammar
test_json_recognizer_accept_string: test the StringRecognizer to verify if a complete JSON string is fully accepted by the grammar
parse_ebnf_grammar: parse an EBNF grammar file into a structured grammar encoding for use with StringRecognizer
test_json_examples_systematic: test a suite of JSON examples including nested objects, arrays, and mixed types against the grammar
test_minimal_json_object: test that a minimal JSON object is correctly recognized as both a valid prefix and complete string
